summary: BI Developer with nearly two years of freelance experience building Power BI dashboards and decision-ready reporting. My work spans sales and retail, churn, supply chain, e-commerce, customer satisfaction, marketing, HR, and healthcare, with a focus on data preparation, validation, SQL and Power Query, dimensional modeling, and KPI design. I also work with Python and SQL on applied machine-learning projects and use Excel and VBA to streamline repeatable reporting.

bullets: Queried an approximately 79-million-row search-performance warehouse with DuckDB and SQL, aggregating Parquet data for analysis.
Developed Python-based feature-preparation workflows and machine-learning experiments using anonymized search-performance data.
Explored temporal and client-grouped validation approaches to assess model generalization and identify potential data-leakage risks.
Completed a capstone project that was independently reviewed and approved.
Deliver confidential BI engagements, translating business questions into Power BI reports, KPI definitions, semantic models, and DAX measures.
Shape source data with Power Query and SQL, and document metric definitions, transformation logic, and reporting handover.

current_focus: Power BI dashboards and decision-ready reporting, supported by trustworthy KPI definitions, dimensional models, data validation, and practical Excel and workflow automation.
about_paragraphs: I’m a BI Developer with nearly two years of freelance experience turning business questions and scattered data into clear, reliable Power BI dashboards. I work across the reporting process—from data preparation and validation with Excel, SQL, and Power Query to dimensional modeling, DAX measures, KPI definitions, interactive reports, and practical handover documentation.

My work has touched sales and retail, churn, supply chain, e-commerce, customer satisfaction, marketing, HR, and healthcare. Beyond BI, I’ve worked with Python, SQL, and DuckDB on search-performance data during an ML internship, and I build independent analytics and automation projects. I hold a BSc and use Excel/VBA automation to make reporting more efficient and repeatable.
